description: This file contains the definition of the Cron class within the Opencart.Admin.Model.Setting namespace. The class provides methods to manage cron jobs, including adding, deleting, editing, and retrieving cron entries from the database. The file appears to be part of the backend model layer of the OpenCart admin system for handling scheduled tasks.

classes.name: Cron
classes.description: This class provides CRUD operations and retrieval methods for managing cron jobs in the OpenCart admin system.

methods.name: addCron
methods.description: Inserts a new cron job entry into the database with specified parameters.

methods.name: deleteCron
methods.description: Deletes a cron job entry identified by its cron_id.

methods.name: deleteCronByCode
methods.description: Deletes a cron job entry based on its code.

methods.name: editCron
methods.description: Updates the modification timestamp of a cron job identified by cron_id.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the active/inactive status of a cron job identified by cron_id.

methods.name: getCron
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific cron job by its cron_id.

methods.name: getCronByCode
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific cron job by its code.

methods.name: getCrons
methods.description: Retrieves a list of cron jobs with optional sorting, ordering, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalCrons
methods.description: Returns the total count of cron jobs in the database.
